title: Playtest switches
description: The file game/tuning/playtest.json. The two switches for playtesting from 08-difficulty.md, rule 5. true: the level table applies (rules 3 and 4). false: Level 1 values at every level, as_level included. Loaded and checked by game/app/tuning.py at startup (docs/contracts/systems/app.md, Rules, Tuning loader). Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/drifters.md.

hazard_speed_scaling.description: Apply the level's Hazard speed x to every drifter's speed at birth (08-difficulty.md, rule 3).

timer_scaling.description: Apply the level's Timer x to every drifter's timers at birth (08-difficulty.md, rule 4). Never touches entry warnings.
